# GF Gone Global

> First-hand gluten-free and celiac travel guides from one celiac traveler (diagnosed 2009): 74 city guides across 28 countries, with restaurants rated for celiac safety, hotels, things to do, maps, and day-by-day trip itineraries.

How to read the site:

- Each city guide lists restaurants with a GF score out of 5 (5 = eat with confidence, 1 = caution; 100% gluten-free restaurants automatically score 5), plus a city-level GF score out of 10.
- Each country page has a country-level GF score out of 10, judged on its own merits rather than averaged from city scores.
- "Went here" marks places the author personally visited. "Traveler recommended" marks places included from research and reviews, not a personal visit.
- Scores and details reflect the visit date shown on each page. Restaurant hours, menus, and gluten-free procedures change, so confirm current details with the venue.
- Full scoring method: https://gfgoneglobal.com/gf-scoring

## About

- [About](https://gfgoneglobal.com/about): I was diagnosed with celiac disease in 2009. This is my travel journal: 28 countries and 76 cities, with notes on where I've eaten gluten-free.
- [How Things Are Scored](https://gfgoneglobal.com/gf-scoring): How GF Gone Global scores countries, cities, and restaurants for gluten-free and celiac travelers, starting from my own meals and research.
- [Privacy Policy](https://gfgoneglobal.com/privacy): What GF Gone Global collects (not much), the analytics and affiliate partners it uses, and how to opt out.

## Itineraries

- [12 Nights Across Austria, Slovakia, Hungary, Liechtenstein & Switzerland: A Gluten-Free Itinerary](https://gfgoneglobal.com/itineraries/austria-slovakia-hungary-liechtenstein-switzerland-2023): A first-hand, 12-night gluten-free itinerary through Austria, Slovakia, Hungary, Liechtenstein, and Switzerland — Vienna, Budapest, Salzburg, Innsbruck, Vaduz, and Zurich — with celiac-safe GF scores for every stop. Traveled November 2023.
- [3 Days in Edinburgh: A Gluten-Free Itinerary](https://gfgoneglobal.com/itineraries/edinburgh-3-days): A first-hand, day-by-day gluten-free itinerary for 3 days in Edinburgh — where I stayed, hiked, and ate as a celiac traveler, including a 10-course tasting menu at LYLA. Visited July 2024.
- [2 Weeks Across Germany, Czech Republic & Italy: A Gluten-Free Itinerary](https://gfgoneglobal.com/itineraries/germany-czech-italy-2018): A first-hand, 13-night gluten-free itinerary through Germany, Czech Republic, and Italy — Frankfurt, Berlin, Prague, Munich, Florence, and Rome — with celiac-safe GF scores for every stop. Traveled May 2018.
- [Gluten-Free Travel Itineraries](https://gfgoneglobal.com/itineraries/): First-hand, day-by-day gluten-free travel itineraries — real trips, real celiac-safe restaurant picks, no guesswork.
- [2 Weeks in Japan: A Gluten-Free Itinerary](https://gfgoneglobal.com/itineraries/japan-2025): A first-hand, 13-night gluten-free itinerary through Japan — Tokyo, Hakone, Kyoto, Osaka, and a Nara day trip — with celiac-safe GF scores for every stop. Traveled March 2025.
- [4 Days in Kyoto: A Gluten-Free Itinerary](https://gfgoneglobal.com/itineraries/kyoto-4-days): A first-hand, day-by-day gluten-free itinerary for 4 days in Kyoto — a cycling tour through Arashiyama, a traditional tea ceremony, a soccer match, and the soy milk ramen spot I found by accident. Visited March 2025.
- [2 Weeks Across Norway, Sweden & Finland: A Gluten-Free Itinerary](https://gfgoneglobal.com/itineraries/norway-sweden-finland-2019): A first-hand, 14-night gluten-free itinerary through Norway, Sweden, and Finland — Oslo, Flåm, Bergen, Stavanger, Stockholm, Tampere, and Helsinki — with celiac-safe GF scores for every stop. Traveled September–October 2019.
- [2 Weeks in Scotland: A Gluten-Free Itinerary](https://gfgoneglobal.com/itineraries/scotland-2024-highlands-islands): A first-hand, 13-night gluten-free itinerary through Scotland — Glasgow, Fort William, the Isle of Skye, Inverness, and Edinburgh — with celiac-safe restaurant picks for every stop. Traveled July 2024.
- [The Soča Trail: Trenta to Bovec, a Gluten-Free Hiking Guide](https://gfgoneglobal.com/itineraries/soca-trail-trenta-bovec): Maybe my favorite thing I did in Slovenia: a first-hand guide to hiking the Soča Trail from Trenta to Bovec, with the early bus, the route with photos, a downloadable GPX, and what to pack as a celiac hiker. Hiked September 2026.
- [4 Days in Tokyo: A Gluten-Free Itinerary](https://gfgoneglobal.com/itineraries/tokyo-4-days): A first-hand, day-by-day gluten-free itinerary for 4 days in Tokyo — split across the start and end of a longer Japan trip — including where I ate, stayed, and the flagship gluten-free omakase lunch worth booking twice. Visited March 2025.

### Sweden

- [Sweden](https://gfgoneglobal.com/countries/sweden): A celiac traveler's guide to gluten-free Sweden — covering Stockholm and Uppsala, one of Europe's most celiac-friendly countries with strong awareness driven by the Swedish Celiac Society.
- [Gluten-Free Stockholm, Sweden: Celiac Restaurant Guide](https://gfgoneglobal.com/countries/sweden/stockholm): First-hand celiac travel guide to Stockholm with 6 GF-rated restaurants, 7/10 safety score, hotel reviews, and interactive maps. Visited September 2019.
- [Gluten-Free Uppsala, Sweden: Celiac Restaurant Guide](https://gfgoneglobal.com/countries/sweden/uppsala): First-hand celiac travel guide to Uppsala with 3 GF-rated restaurants, 6/10 safety score, landmarks, and interactive maps. Visited September 2019.
